definitions.explanation: The people in general, especially when considered as a group that uses shared facilities or services. Almost always used as a modifier before another noun.

examples.japanese: {公衆|こうしゅう}トイレ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
{公衆|こうしゅう}⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦だんだん→だんだん：00832_dandan⟧⟦{少|すく}なく→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Public phones are gradually becoming fewer.

examples.japanese: {公衆|こうしゅう}{衛生|えいせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{向上|こうじょう}→向上：02731_koujou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{感染症|かんせんしょう}→感染症：15681_kansenshou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予防|よぼう}→予防：03669_yobou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: Improvement of public hygiene is essential for the prevention of infectious diseases.

notes:
Almost exclusively used as a compound modifier before another noun. Rarely appears on its own.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {公衆|こうしゅう}トイレ (public restroom)
- {公衆|こうしゅう}⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧ (public telephone, payphone)
- {公衆|こうしゅう}{衛生|えいせい} (public hygiene/health)
- {公衆|こうしゅう}⟦{浴場|よくじょう}→浴場：13350_yokujou⟧ (public bathhouse)
- {公衆|こうしゅう}⟦{道徳|どうとく}→道徳：03478_doutoku⟧ (public morals)
- {公衆|こうしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{面前|めんぜん} (in public, in front of everyone)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{公共|こうきょう}→公共：11652_koukyou⟧: public (emphasizing communal ownership or service)
- {公衆|こうしゅう}: the public as people / for public use (often in compound nouns for shared facilities)
